injectables.name: Dalamud
injectables.note: Verified loading under the host's own wine, wine-xiv, and Proton alike. The tier is what it is because this is third-party code inside the game client, not because of the runner underneath it.
caveats: Third-party code is loaded into the game client. It is not Square Enix's and it is not this launcher's.
A game patch usually leaves it behind for a day or two. Until it catches up it is not loaded, and the game starts without it.

verbs.name: no-desktop-integration
verbs.reason: Wine writes desktop entries and file associations into the host session when a program in the prefix creates a shortcut. A prefix the launcher manages has no business adding entries to the user's application menu, so this is applied before any Windows program is run in one.
